test_cache_enable_disable: test that cache enable and disable updates the is_cache_enabled state correctly on a model
test_cache_hooks_registered: test that cache hooks are properly registered on model modules and removed after disabling cache
test_pab_cache_inference: test pyramid attention broadcast cache inference by running two passes with different inputs and comparing outputs
test_fbc_cache_inference: test first block cache inference using cache_context to populate and skip blocks with cached residuals
test_faster_cache_inference: test faster cache inference with timestep-based skip range to populate cache on first pass and reuse on second
